title: Head of AI & Data Transformation
description:
We are seeking a Head of AI & Data Transformation to lead enterprise-wide AI adoption across insurance operations in Southeast Asia. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on delivery ownership.

Key Responsibilities:
- Define and execute the AI transformation roadmap across claims, underwriting, fraud, and customer experience
- Build and lead an AI Centre of Excellence; establish MLOps governance and model risk frameworks
- Own delivery of ML models in production (claims triage, fraud detection, pricing)
- Drive cloud migration and modernisation of legacy insurance platforms
- Present AI program outcomes to C-suite and Board; manage regulatory alignment with local regulators
- Lead cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders

Requirements:
- 12+ years in technology leadership; 5+ years in AI/ML delivery in production
- Deep insurance domain knowledge: claims, underwriting, fraud, pricing
- Hands-on ML experience: XGBoost, LightGBM, neural networks, cloud ML platforms (AWS SageMaker or Azure ML)
- Experience with real-time data platforms (Kafka, Spark) and modern data stack (Databricks, Snowflake, dbt)
- Track record of enterprise cloud migrations at scale
- Board-level communication and stakeholder management experience
- APAC / Southeast Asia experience strongly preferred
- TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification a plus
- Agentic AI and LLM orchestration experience a strong differentiator
